diagram_previews.alt: Four 3 by 3 grids, each with a blue path starting at the red dot in the top left cell and moving right first, with the numbers 1 to 9 written along the path: corner, top row, right column, then around the bottom and left to finish in the centre; the same but ending in the bottom left corner after passing the centre; top row, back through the middle row, then along the bottom row; and top two cells, down through the centre, along the left and bottom, ending up the right column at the top right corner.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
